response.rationale:
These look like two different capabilities that share one part, online payment. They are not the same capability.

A is about payment and refunds. It sits in community:3, the group built around the PuckPay client (node 8ce0b3f14177346a, an infrastructure class used by 3 others) and the booking, hire-stock and session repositories.

B is about selling tickets, with payment as one step of that. It sits in component:business, a broader domain group that also holds ClubService, ReportService and IceMonitorService.

The only class they have in common is RinkService (node 21c65604dec116b1), which calls 22 other classes. Both labels point at it, but that alone does not make them the same capability. A is about handling the money, including refunds. B is about the sale itself, and it says nothing about refunds.

My confidence is moderate because the only code shown is the two class declarations. I cannot see the methods that would show whether ticket sales and payment are really separate.
